title: The Witness of the Fens Revisited
author: Lena Whitlock
blurb: Sable Oyelaran, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
